title: Nexon closes MapleStory developer NXC's Seattle studio, 120 laid off
content: Nexon America has shut down its Seattle-based studio responsible for MapleStory's North American operations and live service support. Approximately 120 employees were affected. The closure is part of a broader restructuring by parent company NXC Corporation, which is consolidating its global live-ops teams back to South Korea and Japan. Nexon cited 'operational efficiency and centralization of our core development capabilities' as the primary driver. This follows similar consolidations at Nexon's EU offices in Hamburg earlier this year.
